zoe: Planning to cut RC-9134 during the 22:00 UTC change window. Need owners for sheriff, deploy lead, and rollback exec. Also confirm artifact pin and release notes.
deploybot: RC-9134 created from `main@a1b2c3`. Artifacts pinned: `inference-edge:9134` (sha: deadbeef0011). Preflight available.
raj: I can sheriff 21:45-22:30 UTC.
kelsey: I'll run release notes and pin changelog entry. Also will run KV warm on staging.
pat_oncall: There's a minor schema migration queued that touches `model_meta`. Owner agreed to hold merge until 23:00 UTC if we need it.
 harry_releng: Please add a clear rollback snippet in the runbook. Suggested quick rollback (manual):
```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/inference-edge inference-edge=redwood/inference:9120
curl -X POST https://config.internal/flags -d '{"use_new_inference":false}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $KMS_TOKEN"
```
kelsey: Running KV warm and preflight now.
deploybot: Preflight OK: KV warm (prod-sim): 9/9 keys primed. Smoke tests: 2/2 ok (short gen + route sanity). Health checks within baseline.
zoe: Rollback playbook updated: https://wiki.redwood/ops/rc-9134-rollback. Roles: Raj=sheriff, Zoe=deploy lead, Pat=rollback exec, Kelsey=notes. Any objections to 22:00 cut?
raj: No objections. I'll monitor canary and metrics.
deploybot: Promo scheduled: RC-9134 -> prod at 22:00 UTC. Canary: 3% for 8m, 30% for 12m, then 100%. Auto-fallback to image 9120 if error rate >4% or latency p95 > 2x baseline.
pat_oncall: If canary breaches, I will trigger rollback and post status.
zoe: OK, final green. See channel at 21:55 for go/no-go. :rocket:
